reassessment_reason: The historical search-only assessment missed the official paid Business List Service and its public three-sheet schema. Existing offline processing is implemented; this correction does not authorize acquiring or admitting a package.

access.bulk: The official Business List Service advertises the full registered-business list at $0.01 per record, subscribers only. Utah.gov subscription registration costs $125 annually and requires an account and Network Registration Agreement acceptance. Customized lists cost $5 for the first 200 records and $0.05 per additional record.
access.api: No supported unattended business-list API, request-rate contract or delivery automation permission was established.
access.search: The separate business-entity search is public registry access. The paid list service offers entity-type, NAICS, ZIP, change-window, new-registration-window and Active/Expired/Inactive registration filters.

fields.summary: The official example publishes BUSENTITY, BUSINFO and PRINCIPAL sheets joined by Entity ID. BUSENTITY includes entity number/ID, name, type, administrative address/ZIP, registration/expiration/status/change/renewal fields and NAICS. Applicant Name, all BUSINFO content and all PRINCIPAL fields are excluded from projection. The implemented offline connector hash-binds original.xlsx and validates operator-derived JSONL but does not parse or reproducibly extract the workbook or authenticate publisher origin.

active_status_semantics: Active/Expired/Inactive are registration filters; license status and status reason are administrative registration evidence, not proof of current business operation. A complete status codebook and its mapping to the product remain unresolved.
statewide_completeness: The publisher advertises its full registered-business database, but a selected delivered package, included entity population, row totals and current schema guarantee have not been verified. It is not a census of operating businesses or physical establishments.
address_zip: BUSENTITY has Address, Address 2, City, State and ZipCode. Addresses remain administrative registration evidence, not verified physical sites. ZIP5 and ZIP4 stay separate; name/address fields can still identify natural persons despite exclusion of explicit person-role fields.
automation_terms_fees: Full-list access is paid and subscriber-only. The $125 annual subscription and $0.01-per-record charge do not authorize enrollment, payment, agreement acceptance or automation. Existing managed UI and app workers only process explicitly selected local packages.
redistribution: Utah.gov terms condition unmodified webpage copying/distribution on personal or informational use; this is not an established commercial derivative license for the paid product. Retention, transformation, geocoding and redistribution rights remain unresolved; outputs stay local-review-only and admission-ineligible.
temporal_refresh: The list page says updated through the previous Tuesday and separately displayed change/new-registration cutoff 09/28/2026 on observation. Preserve these as distinct publisher statements. Change dates refer to filing receipt, not entry; deletion, correction, replay, checksum and exact delivered-as-of controls remain unverified.

citations.evidence: Full-list/custom-list pricing, filters, previous-Tuesday wording, displayed cutoff and filing-receipt change-date semantics.
Business full list is subscribers only; custom-list payment options include credit card or subscriber account.
Public three-sheet field roster and Entity ID joins, with person-bearing fields.
Enrollment requires an account and Network Registration Agreement acceptance.
Conditional unmodified personal/informational webpage-use permission and accuracy/continuity limitations.

strongest_next_action: Retain the existing offline package workflow and correct catalog evidence. Before any acquisition, resolve product-specific unsigned terms, identifier/status/address contracts, current delivery schema, population/counts, checksums, replay semantics and supported automation. Deterministic workbook extraction and source authenticity are separate admission prerequisites. This assessment authorizes no enrollment, payment, contact, network execution, terms acceptance, acquisition or pointer changes.
